maria-okonkwo.rationale: Practical detection engineering, incident response and SIEM hunting directly filter for professional MSSP analyst work. The two-year profile is modest, but the recorded hands-on scope and professional hint support delivery capability without implying senior leadership.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded fully practical detection, response and SIEM hunting tasks demonstrate operational delivery beyond the two-year profile. That applied analyst scope supports professional placement.
